battle.name: 虎嘯山之戰
battle.brief: 1264年六月，南宋夏貴率數萬大軍攻蒙古所築虎嘯城。張庭瑞以五千人當十倍之師；宋軍砲擊則以木柵覆土、牛皮應之，夏貴斷其水道，守軍飲人尿過濾撐持月餘。史樞援軍至而不敢戰，張庭瑞乘懈夜襲，焦德裕以火把惑敵。卡面希臘火為七世紀拜占庭燃燒劑，本役未參戰，只可與宋軍砲、猛火油櫃對照。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 交戰的兩方是南宋與蒙古帝國，而今日四川、湖北之間的宋蒙邊界，實際由兩個各自獨立的指揮系統維繫。南宋方面，此役的發動者是四川安撫制置使兼知重慶府夏貴，這是南宋在四川的軍政最高職銜，掌一路兵民政、節制川峽各州軍與屯田，能調度川東諸郡的兵員與糧秣；宋軍以禁軍為骨幹，輔以各州郡的土軍、義軍與民夫，攻城所需長砲、雲梯、糧食多靠重慶府沿江轉運的船隊與陸路輜重隊，軍令層級多經轉飭而行，戰時指揮往往集中於制置使幕府。宋人視為要害的是開州、達州一線的漕運：川東糧食由長江上溯、再經開達轉往荊湖，一旦渠江渡口為敵所控，兩州之間的漕運即斷，川東會變成一座糧食運不進來的孤城。蒙古方面，東川都元帥府是帝國在川東的統軍機關，隸於中書省與樞密院，節制沿邊州縣，與西川各路、襄樊方向的軍區分屬不同系統；帥府之下設參議一職，參贊軍務、領兵築城，位在都元帥之下而親自主持一線戰役。至元元年行省之制初行，各路都元帥府仍是獨立的軍事樞紐，跨路調兵須經樞密院轉飭。此役蒙古守軍即東川都元帥府參議張庭瑞所部五千人，另有左壁總帥史樞自北方率兵來援，以及參議焦德裕率領的援軍；請援與出兵全靠文書往返，援軍在半個月後才到，這一點在戰局中是關鍵。兩軍同出草原與內地交界地帶，蒙古以騎兵與屯守兵為主幹，宋軍倚重川東州縣的城防與步卒，兩套軍事傳統在渠江東岸的丘陵上正面相撞。
countriesEn: Two states fought here: the Southern Song and the Mongol Empire, and the Song-Mongol frontier across present-day Sichuan and Hubei was in fact held together by two separate command systems. On the Song side the battle was launched by Xia Gui, who held the two highest offices in Song Sichuan at once, Pacification and Deployment Commissioner of Sichuan and Governor of Chongqing Prefecture. That office controlled the troops, militia and garrison farms of the circuits and could draw on the men and grain of eastern Sichuan; the Song army was the imperial guards backed by prefectural militia, irregulars and labour, while the stone-throwing engines, siege ladders and provisions for the operation came up the river from Chongqing by boat and overland by wagon. Command moved through a long chain of written relay, and in the field it concentrated in the commissioner's headquarters. What the Mongols were cutting at was the grain road of eastern Sichuan: supplies came up the Yangtze and then across the Kaizhou-Dazhou corridor toward the Jinghu region, so a single crossing on the Qu River, once held, severed the traffic between the two prefectures and left eastern Sichuan a city that could not be fed. On the Mongol side the Eastern Circuit Commander's Office was the imperial military authority in eastern Sichuan, answerable to the Central Secretariat and the Privy Council, and it controlled the frontier prefectures; it was separate from the western Sichuan circuits and from the armies facing Xiangyang. Below the commander-in-chief sat the staff counsellor, who handled war business in the field and was sent out to build and garrison towns. The Mongol garrison of Huxiao was the five thousand men led by Zhang Tingrui, staff counsellor of that office; help came from the Left Division commander-in-chief Shi Shu and from the relief column led by the counsellor Jiao Deyu. In a world where the empire was being given its provincial structure, these command offices remained independent military knots of their own, and a request for help travelling by document meant the relief arrived weeks later, a fact that shaped the whole battle. The two armies came from the same borderland between steppe and interior: the Mongols with cavalry and garrison troops, the Song with the walled towns and foot soldiers of the eastern Sichuan prefectures.
people: 此役留下的記錄不多，但每個人物都做過關鍵決定。南宋方面，四川安撫制置使兼知重慶府夏貴是全軍的發動者：景定五年六月，他調集數萬大軍自重慶沿江北上，指向虎嘯城，目標是拔掉這個插在開州、達州之間的新築堡壘。攻城過程中他作出兩個決定，一是下令以砲石轟擊新修的城壁，二是察覺城中無井之後斷其水道；第二個決定幾乎致命，守軍卻用極原始的辦法熬了過去。攻守之間，宋軍五名都統同時陣亡，欒俊、雍貴、胡世雄列名其中，此外在鵝溪的追擊中宋軍再折兵千餘。蒙古方面，東川都元帥府參議張庭瑞是此役的主角：1263 年他率五千人來到虎嘯山，在渠江岸邊築城斷漕，1264 年面對十倍於己的宋軍，他判斷不可速戰，決定分地死守、以勞宋師，並立即遣人馳驛至帥府求援；援軍未到的月餘時日裡，他督促士卒立木柵、覆泥土、以大樹張開牛馬皮頂住砲擊，缺水之後又以人尿摻土過濾飲用，士卒嘴生瘡裂而軍心不散。援軍抵達而不敢進戰，張庭瑞便自行決定趁宋軍懈怠，以一千五百人分三路夜襲宋營，一舉斬殺千餘。參議焦德裕是第二個關鍵人物：他率援軍乘夜抵近夏貴營旁，令每名軍士各持三支火把，造成大軍已到的假象，宋軍因而退兵，他再追擊至鵝溪，斬首千餘，奪馬匹兵杖上萬。蒙古左壁總帥史樞出自真定史氏，其父史天澤是元初以治軍知名的名臣；史樞援軍既到而不敢進戰，說明他仍在整頓、顧慮疲兵與地形，卻也讓虎嘯城的反擊被壓後了一段時間。此役沒有留下更多將領的名字，能確定的是雙方都靠幾個個人的判斷扭轉了局面。
peopleEn: The record of this battle is thin, but everyone named in it made a decision that mattered. On the Song side, Xia Gui, Pacification and Deployment Commissioner of Sichuan and Governor of Chongqing Prefecture, was the man who set it in motion: in the sixth month of the fifth year of Jingding he drew together an army of several tens of thousands, moved it north from Chongqing along the river and closed on Huxiao, with the object of pulling out this newly built fortress planted between Kaizhou and Dazhou. During the siege he made two calls: first to order the new wall battered with stone-throwing engines, and then, on learning that the town had no well, to cut its supply of water. The second was very nearly fatal, and the garrison survived it by the most primitive means imaginable. Five Song commanders died in the fighting, with Luan Jun, Yong Gui and Hu Shixiong among them, and the Song lost another thousand men or more in the pursuit at Goose Creek. On the Mongol side, Zhang Tingrui, staff counsellor of the Eastern Circuit Commander's Office, is the central figure of the whole episode. In 1263 he had brought five thousand men to Huxiao to build a town on the bank of the Qu River and break the grain traffic; in 1264, facing a Song army ten times his strength, he judged that a quick decision was impossible, and chose to hold by district and wear the Song down, sending a rider to the command office for help on the spot. Through the month and more before the relief came, he drove his men to raise a wooden fence, pack earth against it, and stretch the hides of cattle and horses over the branches to take the impact of the stones; when the water was cut, the garrison drank its own urine filtered through soil, a few mouthfuls a day, their mouths cracking open, and the garrison did not dissolve. When the relief arrived and hesitated, Zhang Tingrui decided on his own to strike: fifteen hundred men in three columns went into the Song camp by night and killed more than a thousand. The second key man was the counsellor Jiao Deyu: he brought the relief column close to Xia Gui's camp after dark, had every man carry three torches so that the Song saw an army massing in the night, and when the Song withdrew he pursued them to Goose Creek, killing more than a thousand and taking over ten thousand horses and weapons. Shi Shu, commander-in-chief of the Mongol Left Division, came of the Zhending Shi clan, whose father Shi Tianze was one of the empire's noted commanders; that Shi Shu's relief reached the field and then did not engage shows him still reorganising and weighing exhausted men and bad ground, and it also delayed the counterstroke from Huxiao. No other names survive in the record, but the shape of the battle is clear enough: it was turned by the judgement of a few individuals, not by the weight of numbers.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是希臘火：相傳七世紀上半葉，拜占庭工匠把一種以天然瀝青為基的燃燒劑灌入銅管，點燃後用虹吸管推出，最初用在君士坦丁堡與阿拉伯人的地中海爭奪中，配方是帝國最高機密，據說配方隨一艘沉船一同失落。虎嘯山之役在四川渠江東岸，距地中海四千里、距配方出現近六百年，希臘火並不在現場，蒙古帝國也沒有任何一支部隊使用它，這一點必須說清。與它功能最接近、當時在中國境內確實存在的，是宋軍的猛火油櫃與火藥箭：宋人《武經總要》著錄猛火油櫃以筒管盛油、藉唧筒或砲車擲射，用於焚燒敵人攻具與城下器械，同書又收火藥箭、突火槍與霹靂火球一類火藥兵器，說明在十三世紀中葉，把燃燒物投送到敵人身上已是中原、西夏與蒙古共通的技術。此役真正被記載下來的火相關裝備只有兩樣：蒙古軍每人三支火把，用來在夜裡製造援軍已到的假象；以及用大樹張開的牛馬皮，覆在木柵之上吸收砲石衝擊。蒙古軍的其餘裝備是十三世紀的標準配備：騎兵佩弓箭與刀，步卒用長矛，攻守器械就地砍伐樹木、取皮革製成，帳幕、繩索、氈毯隨軍，糧秣與柴薪靠騎兵與駱馬馱運，飲水則依賴城外的溪流與鑿井。守城一方真正最艱難的並非武器，而是水與糧：虎嘯城新築不久，城中無井又遭斷水，守軍以人尿摻土過濾飲用，書稱日飲數勺。對照之下，希臘火的意義不在這座戰場，而在技術譜系：它提醒我們十三世紀的燃燒武器分兩條路走，一條是拜占庭式的天然瀝青投射，另一條是東亞的猛火油櫃加火藥；等到火砲與火槍在東亞成熟，前者很快退出戰爭，而以銅管、銅罐、虹吸為代表的希臘火，到元末明初只剩下東亞抄本裡的圖樣與歐洲文獻中的殘句。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is Greek fire. By the older account, in the first half of the seventh century a Byzantine craftsman filled a bronze tube with a burning mixture based on natural bitumen, lit it and drove it out with a siphon; it was first used in the Byzantine struggle with the Arabs over the Mediterranean around Constantinople, the formula was the empire's highest state secret, and the story runs that the formula went down with a ship that sank. The battle of Huxiao was fought on the east bank of the Qu River in Sichuan, four thousand li from the Mediterranean and nearly six centuries after that formula appeared; Greek fire was not on the field, and no corps of the Mongol Empire was using anything like it, and that has to be said plainly. The closest equivalents actually present in China at the time were the Song naphtha siphon-cart and the fire arrow: the Song military manual Wujing Zongyao records the siphon-cart, in which oil is carried in a tube and thrown or sprayed from a pump or a throwing cart, for burning enemy siege machines and gear below the walls, and the same book records fire arrows, the fire lance and thunder-crash bombs, showing that in the middle of the thirteenth century throwing burning matter at an enemy was a technique shared by the Central Plain, the Xia and the Mongols. Only two fire-related items are actually recorded here: the Mongols' three torches per man, used at night to fake the arrival of a relief army, and the hides of cattle and horses stretched over branches to take the impact of thrown stones. The rest of the Mongol kit was standard for the century: cavalry with bows and knives, foot soldiers with spears, siege and field works cut on the spot from timber and made from hides, tents, ropes and felt trappings carried with the column, provisions and fuel borne by horsemen and pack animals, and water drawn from streams outside the walls or from wells. What really pressed the defenders was not weapons but water and grain: Huxiao was a new town, it had no well, the water was cut, and the garrison drank its own urine filtered through soil, a few mouthfuls a day according to the record. The point of Greek fire on this card is therefore the technical pedigree rather than the battlefield. The burning weapons of the thirteenth century ran on two lines, the Byzantine type that threw natural bitumen and the East Asian line of the naphtha siphon-cart plus gunpowder; once the fire lance and the hand gun matured in the East, the first line left the field of war quickly, and the copper tube, the copper jar and the siphon survived only as drawings in East Asian copies and as a few quoted lines in European sources.
tactics: 此役的戰術是典型的攻城方與守城方的教科書對照。蒙古守軍的處置有四層。第一是據險築城：虎嘯山在渠江東岸，築城目的是卡住開州與達州之間的漕運，屬於在敵後釘下一枚楔子，而不是求一次速決。第二是分地死守、以勞宋師：張庭瑞清楚五千人對數萬人的兵力差距，不出城、不硬碰，把城牆周圍分成數段分兵把守，逼迫宋軍反覆填壕、擺列、攻城，把宋軍的糧秣、銳氣與體力一點一點耗掉，同時遣使往帥府求援。第三是應對砲擊的工事：宋軍以砲石轟擊新築城壁，牆壞便立木柵，木柵壞便覆土，土再壞就用大樹張開牛馬皮覆蓋其上，皮被砲擊便收合——這是一層層換材料，而不是一次加固。第四是夜襲與追擊：援軍到而不敢進戰，張庭瑞便抓住宋軍鬥志鬆懈的窗口，派一千五百人分三路夜襲宋營，殺宋軍都統五人、斬千餘；焦德裕再以火把佈滿營旁，令宋軍誤以為大軍壓到，迫其退兵，再追至鵝溪。宋軍的戰術則有明顯漏洞：以十倍之師圍攻卻只用於一面，既沒有合圍，也沒有先斷敵援兵之路；察覺城中無井後斷水的判斷是全役最精彩的一手，卻沒有配套的攻勢把守軍逼入絕境；營地夜間警戒鬆懈，被一千五百人突入營中，殺將而去；退兵時未設掩護，結果在鵝溪遭追擊，又折千餘人。整體看，這是一場以少勝多、靠工事、耐心與夜襲取勝的守城戰；攻城方輸在急於求成、輕視對手、夜間戒備鬆弛與撤退無紀律。
tacticsEn: The tactics of this battle read like a textbook confrontation between a besieging army and a garrison. The Mongol defence had four layers. First, the site: Huxiao stood on the east bank of the Qu River, and the purpose of building there was to pinch the grain traffic between Kaizhou and Dazhou, to drive a wedge into the enemy's rear rather than to force a quick decision. Second, the method: Zhang Tingrui knew that five thousand men face tens of thousands, so he did not sortie and did not accept a set-piece contest; he divided the circuit into sectors, held each with a separate detachment, and made the Song army fill ditches, form up and assault again and again, wearing away its supplies, its nerve and its strength, while sending for help in the same breath. Third, the works: when the Song stones broke the newly raised wall, the garrison set up a wooden fence; when the fence broke, they packed earth against it; when the earth gave way, they stretched the hides of cattle and horses over the branches and closed them up when the stones came down. Each layer was replaced rather than reinforced, an improvised answer to an improvised engine. Fourth, the night stroke and the pursuit: the relief had arrived and would not fight, so Zhang Tingrui took the opening the Song army's slack discipline gave him, sent fifteen hundred men in three columns into the Song camp after dark, killed five Song commanders and more than a thousand men; then Jiao Deyu filled the night with torches along the camp front so that the Song believed a great army had arrived, forced them to withdraw, and pursued them to Goose Creek. The Song tactics show clear gaps. Ten times the enemy's numbers were thrown at a single face of the city: there was no encirclement, and no attempt to cut the road by which the relief would come. The reading that the town had no well and the order to cut its water was the sharpest move of the day, yet no assault followed to convert it into a surrender. Camp watch at night was thin, and fifteen hundred men walked into the camp and out again carrying the head of the Song command. The withdrawal was not covered, and at Goose Creek the Song lost another thousand men. In sum this was a defence that won with fewer numbers, with works, with patience and with a night attack, while the attackers lost through haste, contempt for the enemy, slack night watch and a retreat without discipline.
data: 可核的數字集中在《續資治通鑑》卷一百七十七的記載裡，其餘多不可考。時間：此役屬宋理宗景定五年、元世祖至元元年，即 1264 年；夏貴大軍在六月攻城，張庭瑞守城「堅持月餘」之後才有夜襲，追擊在鵝溪，具體日數記載未載。兵力：1263 年張庭瑞率軍五千人赴虎嘯山築城，這支部隊是 1264 年的守軍主力；宋軍為數萬，史書並記宋軍兵力十倍於守軍。夜襲：張庭瑞遣一千五百人分三路突入宋營，斬殺千餘人，殺宋軍都統欒俊、雍貴、胡世雄等五人。追擊：焦德裕追至鵝溪，斬首千餘人，獲馬匹、兵杖上萬。距離與地理：虎嘯山在今四川省廣安市東，廣安市政府駐地約在北緯 30.46 度、東經 106.63 度，虎嘯城在渠江東岸；大良平在廣安市東約四十里，鵝溪在廣安市北；渠江自北而南貫穿廣安市境，是川東的航運與漕糧幹道，廣安一帶位於四川盆地中部丘陵區，華蓥山橫亙市境西側。守軍狀況：城中無井，水道被斷後以人尿摻土過濾飲用，書稱日飲數勺，士卒嘴生瘡裂；火把數量記為每名軍士三支。缺口：兩軍的最終傷亡總數、攻城所用砲的數量與砲石消耗、守城月餘的具體起訖日、宋軍死於攻城與撤退者與蒙古軍自身的損失，記載皆缺，史料只能給出上述量級。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are those in volume 177 of the Xu Zizhi Tongjian; beyond them there is very little. Date: the campaign belongs to the fifth year of Jingding under Emperor Lizong and the first year of Zhiyuan under Kublai, that is 1264. Xia Gui's army opened the siege in the sixth month, Zhang Tingrui held the town for a month and more before the night attack, and the pursuit took place at Goose Creek; the exact days are not given. Numbers: in 1263 Zhang Tingrui had taken five thousand men to Huxiao to build the town, and that body was the main garrison in 1264; the Song army was counted as several tens of thousands, and the record states that Song strength was ten times that of the defenders. The night attack: Zhang Tingrui sent fifteen hundred men in three columns into the Song camp, killing more than a thousand and killing five Song commanders, Luan Jun, Yong Gui, Hu Shixiong and two others. The pursuit: Jiao Deyu struck at Goose Creek, killing more than a thousand by head count and taking over ten thousand horses and weapons. Distance and geography: Huxiao lies east of present-day Guang'an City in Sichuan, whose municipal seat stands at about 30.46 degrees north and 106.63 degrees east; the town of Huxiao stood on the east bank of the Qu River. Daliangping lay about forty li east of Guang'an and Goose Creek lay north of it. The Qu River runs north to south through the territory of Guang'an and was the carrying artery for grain and transport in eastern Sichuan; the area sits among the middle hills of the Sichuan basin, with the Huaying range running along the western side of the prefecture. Condition of the garrison: the town had no well, and after the water was cut the men drank urine filtered through soil, a few mouthfuls a day according to the text, their mouths cracking open; the torches are counted at three to a man. Gaps: the final casualty totals of both armies, the number of throwing engines and the consumption of stones, the exact span of the month-long defence, the Song dead in the assaults and on the retreat, and the Mongols' own losses are all absent, and the sources give only the order of magnitude set out above.
cause: 打起來的緣由有三層。最深的一層是蒙古帝國在四川的戰略轉向：蒙古在川東已取得廣安、渠州一帶的城邑，卻處處分兵、處處修城，兵力被攤薄，連年攻不下釣魚城一線；忽必烈於 1260 年建元中統、1264 年改元至元之後，決心把零散據點連成線，先在川東切斷宋人自長江上溯的漕糧，再圖全川。1263 年東川都元帥府派張庭瑞率五千人到虎嘯山築城，位置選在渠江東岸、大良平（今廣安市東四十里，屬宋方）側翼，正是要斷開州與達州之間的漕運並威脅大良平，這是攻勢的前置動作。直接的一層是南宋守方的反應：虎嘯城一天不拔，開州、達州兩州就一天暴露在蒙古騎兵之下，川東糧道隨時可被掐斷；四川安撫制置使夏貴因此不能容忍，遂傾全川可用之兵來攻。深層的一層則是宋蒙在四川的體制差距：蒙古以騎兵為主，既能野戰也能築城屯守，宋軍倚重城防與守禦，攻守之際全靠制置使幕府臨時調度；夏貴位高權重，能夠湊出數萬大軍，卻未能在戰前完成合圍與封鎖，幕府雖知敵必待援，仍沒有把斷援放在攻城之前。換言之，這一戰不是誰突然挑起的，而是一次精心鋪設的據點戰，遇上了一次準備不足的反攻。
causeEn: There are three layers of reason behind the fighting. The deepest is the turning of Mongol strategy in Sichuan. The empire had taken towns in eastern Sichuan around Guang'an and Quzhou, but it kept scattering its strength and building more and more small forts, and year after year it could not take the line of Diaoyu; after Kublai took the reign title Zhongtong in 1260 and Zhiyuan in 1264, he resolved to link the scattered holdings into a chain, cutting the Song grain route that came up the Yangtze in eastern Sichuan first and taking the whole province afterwards. In 1263 the Eastern Circuit Commander's Office sent Zhang Tingrui with five thousand men to build a town at Huxiao, choosing a site on the east bank of the Qu River beside Daliangping, a Song position forty li east of present-day Guang'an, precisely in order to break the grain traffic between Kaizhou and Dazhou and to threaten Daliangping; the town was the preparatory move of the offensive. The immediate layer is the reaction of the Song defenders: for as long as Huxiao stood, Kaizhou and Dazhou lay exposed to Mongol horse and the grain road of eastern Sichuan could be pinched at any moment, and Xia Gui, the Sichuan Pacification Commissioner, could not tolerate that, so he brought to the wall every man he could raise in Sichuan. The third layer is the structural difference between the two war machines in Sichuan: the Mongols fought mounted, could manoeuvre in the open and could also dig in and sit on a town, whereas the Song leaned on walls and defence and improvised its armies through the commissioner's headquarters; Xia Gui had the authority to raise tens of thousands, but he never closed the ring on the town or sealed the road its relief would come by, even though his staff knew the garrison would wait for help. In short this was not a quarrel that flared up suddenly; it was a carefully prepared bridgehead operation met by a counterstroke that was not properly prepared.
impact: 虎嘯山之役的後果，超出一次邊境攻防的份量。它讓蒙古在川東第一次把築城屯兵、斷人漕運這套辦法做成了：虎嘯城立在渠江東岸，成為蒙古東路向開州、達州、夔州推進的一枚釘子，宋人自長江上溯的漕糧線從此多了一段必須提防的缺口，大良平等宋方據點也日夜暴露在蒙古游騎的陰影之下。對南宋而言，此役暴露的是四川防務的結構性問題：制置使雖有調兵之權，卻仍要靠臨時湊集兵力，用傾巢之師打一場沒有合圍的攻堅，結果攻守雙方都沒有得到想要的東西，宋軍折了都統五人與數千兵員，夏貴的攻勢被硬生生擋在渠江東岸。對蒙古而言，此役同樣給出教訓：守城方能靠死守待援、夜襲與追擊，把攻勢拖進自己的節奏；而援軍不敢進戰的拖延，說明蒙古各路都元帥府之間的協同與戰術標準並不統一，此後元軍在攻城技術上轉而倚重西域回回炮與大型攻城器械，正是要解決怎樣更快拆掉宋人城牆這個問題。武器史的角度，這一戰更是一次反證：十三世紀中葉能真正決定守城命運的，不是任何一種奇襲性的燃燒武器，而是水、糧、工事與夜襲。希臘火所代表的投射型燃燒劑在歐亞另一端仍被記錄與使用，而川東的虎嘯城靠的是牛皮、木柵與一口被斷掉的水源。
impactEn: The consequences of Huxiao reach well beyond a border skirmish. It was the first time the Mongols in eastern Sichuan actually executed the recipe of building a town, sitting on it and cutting the enemy's grain traffic. Huxiao stood on the east bank of the Qu River as a nail driven into the road of the Mongol advance toward Kaizhou, Dazhou and Kuizhou; from then on the Song grain route coming up the Yangtze had a gap that had to be watched, and Song positions such as Daliangping lay in the shadow of Mongol patrols day and night. For the Song the battle exposed a structural problem in the defence of Sichuan: the commissioner had the authority to move troops, yet he still had to improvise his army and spent a ten-to-one force on an assault against a single face of the town, with no encirclement, and both sides ended without what they wanted, the Song losing five commanders and several thousand men with Xia Gui's offensive stopped dead on the east bank of the Qu River. For the Mongols the campaign taught its own lessons: a garrison that holds, waits for help, strikes at night and pursues can drag the attack into its own tempo, while the reluctance of the relief to engage shows how uneven the coordination and tactical standards between the various command offices of the empire were. The later Mongol preference for the western counterweight trebuchet and for large siege machines against Song walls was in part an answer to exactly this problem, how to break a Song city faster. From the point of view of the history of weapons, the battle is a refutation: what really decided the fate of a besieged town in the middle of the thirteenth century was water, grain, works and the night, not any weapon of sudden burning. The projection incendiary that Greek fire represents was still being recorded and used at the far end of Eurasia, while the town of Huxiao on the Qu River held on with cowhide, timber and a well that had been cut off.
result: 結果是蒙古守方完勝，宋軍攻城失敗。虎嘯城守住了，張庭瑞以五千人擋住十倍之師，夏貴的大軍在城下一無所獲，最終在焦德裕的火把惑敵之下退兵，又在鵝溪遭追擊，斬首千餘，馬匹兵杖被奪上萬；宋軍都統欒俊、雍貴、胡世雄等五人死于夜襲。守軍的代價同樣慘烈：城中無井而水道被斷，士卒以人尿摻土過濾飲用，日飲數勺，嘴生瘡裂，在斷水狀態下築壘苦守月餘，才等到援軍的消息換來反擊的機會。從戰役得失看，雙方各有收穫：蒙古得到一座可以長期經營的據點與一批繳獲，宋軍在折損兵將之後保住了開州、達州一線，短期內不必再面對城下的砲火；宋廷此後並未立刻再攻虎嘯城，這座城在蒙古手中一直存在，成為忽必烈經略四川的一枚前哨。對卡牌兵器而言，這一戰同時是一份否定清單：希臘火沒有出現在虎嘯山，現場只有宋軍的砲、蒙古的木柵與牛皮、火把與斷水；真正在這條渠江東岸的丘陵上決定勝負的，是工事、是耐心、是一支敢在夜裡分三路摸進敵營的隊伍。
resultEn: The Mongol garrison won outright and the Song siege failed. Huxiao held. Zhang Tingrui threw five thousand men against ten times that number and the town did not fall; Xia Gui's army got nothing from the walls, withdrew in the end after Jiao Deyu's torches made the night look full of enemy, and was caught at Goose Creek with more than a thousand killed and over ten thousand horses and weapons taken away. Five Song commanders, Luan Jun, Yong Gui, Hu Shixiong among them, died in the night attack. The garrison's own cost was brutal in its way: with no well in the town and the water cut, the men drank urine filtered through soil, a few mouthfuls a day, their mouths cracking open, and they dug in and held for a month and more in that state before the news of the relief brought the chance to strike back. Between them the two sides each came away with something: the Mongols gained a garrison town they could keep and a haul of captured stores, while the Song, after losing men and commanders, kept the Kaizhou-Dazhou line and did not have to face the throwing engines under the walls again for the moment. The Song court did not immediately attack Huxiao a second time; the town stayed in Mongol hands and went on serving as an outpost in Kublai's campaigning in Sichuan. For the weapon on the card the battle is also a list of negatives: Greek fire was not at Huxiao, and what was on the ground was the Song stone-throwing engines, the Mongol wooden fence and stretched hides, the torches and the cut water. What settled the matter on those hills above the Qu River was works, patience and a detachment willing to feel its way into the enemy camp by night in three columns.
